name: standing elephant walk
description: A standing forward fold where you bend one knee and straighten the other in turn. It warms up the hamstrings gently before deeper stretching.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and fold forward from your hips.
Place your hands on the floor, on blocks or on your shins.
Bend one knee while you straighten the other leg.
Switch sides in a slow walking rhythm.
Keep your weight over the balls of your feet and your neck relaxed.
